build_game_objects: build all avatar and normal game objects from an ascii map and prefab configurations
build_avatar_objects: build avatar game objects with per-player color palettes and lua indices from a prefab
build_avatar_badges: build avatar badge game objects overlaid on each player avatar with badge palettes
get_game_objects_from_map: extract game object configurations from an ascii map using a character-to-prefab mapping
get_game_object_positions_from_map: extract positions and orientations of a character from an ascii map as transforms
